title: The Own Goal (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal football comedy tragedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The own goal is not a mistake
Well — it is a mistake
But it is a very specific kind of mistake
The kind where you did everything right
And it still ended up wrong

[Verse 2]
The defender who scored the own goal
Was trying to clear the danger
The ball simply had different ideas
The ball has always had different ideas
The ball is not interested in intentions

[Chorus]
The own goal says — I was trying to help
The own goal says — I had the best intentions
The own goal says — the ball went that way
The own goal says — I am so sorry
The net says nothing
The net just holds it

[Bridge]
Chas said — the own goal is the most honest moment in football
Because the player cannot blame anyone else
Not really
Not for long
Not while the replay is still running

[Verse 3]
The walk back to the halfway line after an own goal
Is one of the longest walks in sport
Every step is the exact distance between
What you meant to do
And what actually happened

[Outro]
The own goal
The own goal
That's my boy
